tools.name: start_browser_auth
tools.description: Open App Store Connect sign-in only when needed. If the saved session is still valid, this tool returns success immediately and does not open the viewer. Call session_status first. Use force_reconnect only when the user explicitly wants to wipe the saved cookie and sign in again (destructive).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "start_browser_auth" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-apple_ads" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_inbox, list_notifications · Public sink: add_targeting_keywords · Destructive: delete_targeting_keyword, delete_campaign.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_inbox, list_notifications · Public sink: add_targeting_keywords · Destructive: delete_targeting_keyword, delete_campaign

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
